title: Weather forecast for Earth, Sunday 2000 B.C.: 49-day forecast of rain
summary: A weather-app style joke slide for 'Earth, Sunday, 2000 B.C.': 100% precipitation, 100% humidity and 100+ mph wind, an hourly bar of 100% all day, and a 49-day extended forecast grid (Sun to Sat) with one row of sunny-cloud icons, then rain icons for the following days, and sun icons again on the last two days.
